tagline: Run an X11 desktop over VNC on rootless jailbreaks
description:
A from-source rebuild of TigerVNC's **Xvnc**, a virtual X11 display server with built-in VNC, patched to run on **rootless** jailbreaks.

Stock builds crash on launch because they expect a system shell at `/bin/sh`, which isn't present on rootless (it lives at `/var/jb/bin/sh`). This build uses the right path, so it starts cleanly.

- Built from source and signed to install on rootless
- Installs without errors; the unavailable `tigervnc-xorg-extension` dependency is dropped
- Gives you an X11 desktop you can reach from any VNC client at `127.0.0.1`

Pair it with a window manager (`fluxbox`), `xterm`, and fonts. Built for iPadOS/iOS rootless (palera1n/Dopamine, `/var/jb`).

changelog.notes:
- Rebuilt from source for rootless /var/jb
- Fix: X server spawns its xkbcomp helper via /var/jb/bin/sh (was /bin/sh), so keyboard init no longer crashes
- Drop the unsatisfiable tigervnc-xorg-extension dependency so it installs with dpkg/apt
